prose.name: Hunt: Escaped Test Subjects on <Planet>
prose.briefing: A research station lost its test subjects in a containment failure, and they have gone to ground at the <Place>. The staff have sealed themselves in and nobody is opening a door until every one is dead.

broadcast: Containment failed and our test subjects got out. They've gone to ground nearby. We've sealed ourselves in. Nobody opens a door until they're dead.

beats.objective: Put down the test subjects at the <Place>
beats.journal: Every one of the escaped test subjects at the <Place> is dead. The station can open its doors again.
beats.say: That's the last of them. We can open the doors. Thank you.
